no-restricted-properties.message: An amount is an exact minor-unit integer, so it never needs rounding. Reaching for Math.round here means the value has left integer arithmetic.
Format an amount from its integer minor units and the currency exponent (modules/money/format). toFixed rounds a binary float and silently loses cents.
An amount arrives as an exact minor-unit integer, never as a float string. Use modules/money to parse an amount or its currency.
